meta.name: Zindagi inShort
meta.description:
Complicated marriages, digital romances, domestic dilemmas and schoolyard bullies get the spotlight in these seven, slice-of-life short films.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 19 Feb 2020 · India · Language: Hindi · 17 min
Studio: Sikhya Entertainment · Network: Flipkart Video, Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Pinni
videos.overview: A young couple discovers the freedoms and limitations of digital dating when their crackling online chemistry faces real-world hurdles.

videos.title: Sleeping Partner
videos.overview: Sudha, in her 60's is a happy, diligent homemaker who is abreast of current affairs much against the general stereotype of a homemaker. But her rebellion again true to her nature is far from the expected.

videos.title: Sunny Side Upar
videos.overview: Sleeping Partner is a 2020 Hindi-language drama film that sheds light on domestic violence and marital rape.

videos.title: Nano So Phobia
videos.overview: For a young, workaholic doctor, love, family and friends are on the bottom rung of priorities — until a personal tragedy leads her to reconsider.

videos.title: Chhaju Ke Dahi Bhalle
videos.overview: A septuagenarian’s growing loneliness finds expression in the escalation of a long-standing phobia brought on by an incident in her past.

videos.title: Thappad
videos.overview: In a distant village, a schoolboy draws from his love of comic books to hatch an imaginative plan he hopes will help his sister stand up to bullying.

videos.title: Swaaha
videos.overview: While at a family wedding, a couple’s marriage quickly becomes a comical spectacle as the insecure husband confronts his wife about her infidelity.
